description:
Perform a representative positive end-to-end review of the completed policy-grounded code-review behavior and capture auditable evidence in a durable report. The report demonstrates that the integrated procedure and structured contract work on attributable repository changes without requiring a separate live negative fixture.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A Markdown report at `dev/active/b4e55aa2-code-review-live-verification.md` records the gate-run ID, reviewer session ID, exact attributable commit set, model, reasoning effort, and prompt and context measurements.
- [hard] REQ-02: The report identifies every applicable `AGENTS.md` path, each resolved qualified ID, and the configured source of truth used for each item.
- [hard] REQ-03: The captured review emits all five evidence-header fields and records the final verdict plus every parsed finding's `references` array.
- [hard] REQ-04: The report records every relevant truncation event and its narrower recovery, or explicitly records `Truncation recovery: none` when no relevant evidence was truncated.
- [hard] REQ-05: The representative run demonstrates bounded inspection, current gate-evidence consumption, valid qualified-item resolution, and a valid terminal verdict and findings contract over the completed implementation.
- [hard] REQ-06: Deterministic negative coverage remains the source for failure-path verification; the live report does not introduce a fragile standalone negative fixture.
title: Record a representative policy-grounded live review
